# pvecli pool export

Export all pools to a JSON file.

```text
pvecli pool export [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `-o`, `--output VALUE` | `pools.json` | Output file path. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile to use. |
